what: proof that the real-fluid property path, not the ideal-gas path, is what executes

case.solver_resolution: PATH resolves to the profile binary, not the stock executable of the same name; see records/identity-chain.json
case.divergence_from_upstream: endTime truncated from 0.02 to 0.002 to bound wall time; no other input changed. The modified controlDict is retained in case/system/controlDict.

thermophysical_path.evidence: the solver's own log lines, reproduced in logs/run-tail.txt under THERMO SELECTION
thermophysical_path.interpretation: this is the real-fluid property path: a cubic Peng-Robinson equation of state with Chung's kinetic transport and the package's own rfSpecie/rfJanaf thermodynamics. It is not the ideal-gas path, and the case also ships a commented ideal-gas thermoType for comparison.

result.termination: normal `End`, reached the requested endTime exactly

supported: the package builds with zero errors on this toolchain, with its outputs separated from stock
the stock OpenFOAM-8 installation is byte-for-byte unchanged after the build (four md5s identical)
a case exercising the Peng-Robinson real-fluid property path meshes, initialises, and integrates to the requested end time with a normal termination
the solver that ran is the profile build, and its modified-physics libraries resolved from the profile directory rather than from stock
not_supported: the continuity values are first and last sampled entries only, not a history and not a maximum; they are the solver's `time step continuity errors`, which is not a linear-solver residual and not evidence of physical convergence
nothing about accuracy, grid convergence, or correctness of the real-fluid physics
nothing about trans- or super-critical combustion, which is the project's target; this is an isothermal-species advection case with no reactions and no flame
nothing about the containerised agent runtime; the solver ran in a host shell through the profile environment

case_retention.inputs: case/ holds the system dictionaries, thermophysicalProperties, chemistryProperties, combustionProperties and the full 0/ initial and boundary fields
case_retention.logs: logs/run-tail.txt is an excerpt; the complete 5690-line solver log, and the blockMesh and setFields logs, remain with the retained case on the host
case_retention.note: the previous bundle deleted its case and kept only numbers. This one keeps the inputs so the run is exactly replayable.
